signals.name: boot_fsm_ns
signals.note: R-Y2 (§Phase 8): per-signal anyconst on the bug-bearing FSM register so the CWE-1245 encodings {5,6,7} are reachable from init without the global -anyseq cap-explosion. Other undefs stay at -zero per the global YosysOptions default.

properties.description: Baseline smoke test: every reachable state has at least one outgoing transition.

CWE-1245 safety: the boot FSM's next-state register must never carry an unmatched encoding (5/6/7 are not in the case statement of the buggy variant; default-less unique casez admits them as absorbing sinks). Phase A.3 note: Yosys `flatten` + `dffunmap` retains the next-state register `boot_fsm_ns` in the bit-blasted BTOR2 — the original SV name `boot_fsm_ps` does not survive synthesis as a separate cell.
Liveness: BOOT_IDLE (encoding 0) is reachable from any state via some path.
